events.title: Supreme Administrative Court annuls the Žďár Senate election (one-vote complaint); the race is re-run from the first round
events.note: Covered as a story; its headline forecast a dismissal, the court annulled the result instead.

events.title: Babiš, Zůna and Macinka in Israel: Spyder All-in-One air-defence offer, tender possible next year
events.note: Planning dropped 'Babiš's last day in Israel: any air-defence document signed': no signing, memorandum or press conference announced for 18 Nov, only the Ichilov hospital visit. The Spyder offer was carried by edition 2026-11-18 (cz-babis).

events.title: Prague coalition (STAN, Spolu, Praha sobě) signs its agreement and presents the council; Hlaváček to be mayor
events.note: Planning dropped it: names agreed by the parties, the votes (mayor, council) are on 19 Nov, next edition. Counted for ctk via the ČTK-credited ČT24 item.

events.title: Interior minister Metnar: Russian athletes will not be let into Czechia (Russian hockey teams at world championships)
events.note: A meeting of Šťastný, Macinka, Metnar and the hockey unions was announced on 1 Nov (ČTK) without a date; no dated announcement of the 18 Nov meeting found, and Macinka's visa refusal was already public on 17 Nov. Not treated as a sweep gap.

events.title: Police treat the Prague main-station train collision as negligent endangerment (up to eight years)
events.note: Follow-up to the 17 Nov accident (missed in edition 2026-11-18); not announced in advance; no sweep gap.

events.title: Unions at the National Institute of Public Health (SZÚ) declare strike alert over 10% job cuts
events.note: Not announced in advance; no sweep gap.

events.title: Justice minister Tejc: court proceedings shortened again; amendment to stop appeal courts binding lower courts
events.note: Ministry statistics release and briefing; no advance announcement found (the ČT24 day plan for 18 Nov could not be retrieved); no sweep gap.

events.title: Christmas-market stalls burn on náměstí Svobody in Brno
events.note: An accident, not announced in advance; no sweep gap.
